description: This file contains the implementation of Drupal hooks for the locale module, specifically for handling interface translation, language configuration, cache management, and related administrative functions.

classes.name: LocaleHooks
classes.description: Class implementing Drupal hooks for the locale module, managing help content, language configuration, cache, and translation updates.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Provides help and informational content for various locale-related routes.

methods.name: configurableLanguageInsert
methods.description: Handles actions after inserting a new configurable language, such as cache clearing and JS cache invalidation.

methods.name: configurableLanguageUpdate
methods.description: Handles actions after updating a configurable language, including cache clearing and JS cache invalidation.

methods.name: configurableLanguageDelete
methods.description: Handles cleanup after deleting a language, including removing translations, translation files, and cache invalidation.

methods.name: modulesInstalled
methods.description: Updates system when modules are installed.

methods.name: modulePreuninstall
methods.description: Removes system updates when a module is uninstalled.

methods.name: themesInstalled
methods.description: Updates system when themes are installed.

methods.name: themesUninstalled
methods.description: Removes system updates when themes are uninstalled.

methods.name: cron
methods.description: Performs scheduled translation update tasks if configured.

methods.name: jsAlter
methods.description: Replaces placeholder JavaScript translation files with actual translation files based on current language.

methods.name: libraryInfoAlter
methods.description: Adds dependency on locale translations to core/drupal library when locale module is enabled.

methods.name: formLanguageAdminOverviewFormAlter
methods.description: Adds translation progress info to language overview form.

methods.name: formLanguageAdminAddFormAlter
methods.description: Adds submit handlers to add language form.

methods.name: formLanguageAdminEditFormAlter
methods.description: Adds checkbox to enable translation to English in edit language form.

methods.name: formSystemFileSystemSettingsAlter
methods.description: Adds interface translation directory setting to file system configuration form.
